<!-- Generated by docs/scripts/cli_reference.py from the programs themselves: edit those, not this page. -->

Detect spikes in a whole recording and write them as a sorting (one unit per channel)

```text
dspk detect [OPTIONS] --output <OUTPUT> <RECORDING>
```

**Arguments**

- **`<RECORDING>`**  
  Recording (SpikeGLX .bin / .cbin, raw .bin + JSON .meta, NWB, Zarr)

**Options**

- **`--source <SOURCE>`**  
  Source within the file (an id `dspk-cli open` lists); default: the largest electrical one
- **`--probe <PROBE>`**: one of `neuropixels1`, `neuropixels2`, `tetrode`, `utah`, `hdemg4x8`, `hdemg8x8`  
  Probe preset; default: the geometry the recording carries (SpikeGLX), else an error
- **`--probe-file <PROBE_FILE>`**  
  Probe file (.json: probeinterface or Kilosort 4) saying which channel each contact is wired to: the data is read in contact order (unconnected contacts left out), with its geometry
- **`--channel-map <CHANNEL_MAP>`**  
  Channel map (.toml / .json, pairs under `remap`) applied after the probe: channels reordered, dropped, renamed; the geometry follows them
- **`--pitch-um <PITCH_UM>`**: default `8000`  
  Electrode pitch of HD-EMG grid presets (µm)
- **`--start-sec <START_SEC>`**: default `0`  
  Start of the part to process (s)
- **`--duration-sec <DURATION_SEC>`**  
  Length of the part to process (s); default: to the end
- **`-o, --output <OUTPUT>`**  
  Output folder or store
- **`--format <FORMAT>`**  
  Output format; default: from the name (`.nwb.zarr` → nwb, other `.zarr` → zarr, else phy)
  - `phy`: Phy / Kilosort folder (`.npy` arrays, `.tsv` tables)
  - `zarr`: dspk `.sorting.zarr` store
  - `nwb`: NWB `/units` table in a `.nwb.zarr` store
- **`--car <CAR>`**: default `true`, one of `true`, `false`  
  Common average reference before filtering
- **`--band-low-hz <BAND_LOW_HZ>`**: default `300`  
  Band-pass low edge (Hz)
- **`--band-high-hz <BAND_HIGH_HZ>`**: default `5000`  
  Band-pass high edge (Hz); must be below Nyquist
- **`--threshold <THRESHOLD>`**: default `5`  
  Threshold in multiples of each channel's noise σ (MAD)
- **`--refractory-ms <REFRACTORY_MS>`**: default `1`  
  Smallest interval between two spikes on a channel (ms)
- **`--polarity <POLARITY>`**: default `negative`, one of `negative`, `positive`, `both`  
  Which extrema are spikes
- **`--spacing <SPACING>`**  
  Which of two nearer crossings stays
  - `locally-exclusive`: A crossing stays unless a larger one is nearer (streaming equals whole-recording detection)
  - `scipy`: As `scipy.signal.find_peaks(distance=…)` (may differ at batch edges)
- **`--radius-um <RADIUS_UM>`**: default `150`  
  Crossings within this radius (and the refractory window) are one spike (µm)
- **`--k-neighbors <K_NEIGHBORS>`**: default `4`  
  Channels per waveform snippet (the primary and its nearest)
- **`--pre-ms <PRE_MS>`**: default `1`  
  Snippet window before the trough (ms)
- **`--post-ms <POST_MS>`**: default `2`  
  Snippet window after the trough (ms)
- **`--sinc-shift <SINC_SHIFT>`**: default `true`, one of `true`, `false`  
  Realign snippets to the sub-sample trough
- **`--locate <LOCATE>`**: default `true`, one of `true`, `false`  
  Locate every spike (centre of mass of its snippet's heights over its neighbours)
- **`--batch-sec <BATCH_SEC>`**: default `10`  
  Length of each processing window (s); memory only, not results
- **`--calibration-sec <CALIBRATION_SEC>`**: default `5`  
  Total length of the noise calibration (s)
- **`--calibration-chunks <CALIBRATION_CHUNKS>`**: default `5`  
  Chunks the noise calibration is spread over
